name: A.L.A.N.: Briseurs de Failles
source:
A.L.A.N.
Alex and his friends are Rift Breakers. They must protect their city while fighting the monsters spawning from the Rifts.

Rift Breakers
Alex thought he was a kid like any other, until he becomes a Rift Breaker. Now, he must team up with Lily, Nana and Aimé to battle the monsters spawning from the Rifts, mysterious cracks of lights. 

Two connected linear stories…
A.L.A.N.: Rift Breakers!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/918120/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
艾伦
亚历克斯和他的朋友们是裂缝破坏者。他们必须保护自己的城市，同时与裂缝中产生的怪物战斗。

裂缝破坏者
亚历克斯认为他和其他人一样是个孩子，直到他成为一名裂缝破坏者。现在，他必须与莉莉、娜娜和艾梅联手，对抗从裂缝、神秘的光裂缝中产生的怪物。

两个相互关联的线性故事……
A.L.A.N.：裂痕破坏者！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/918120/]Steam[/url]]
